rules_tr: Japonca ses kadrosu. 'locked' sesler eski projeden (E:/Unity/unaware-of-my-demise narrative/10_VO/Line_Maps/casting.json, 2026-10-16 kilit; kötüler tools/build_villains_and_boss_voices.py) ve oyundaki kayıtlarla aynı; değişmez. 'audition' satırları sahibin dinleyip seçmesi için adaylar; seçilen ses 'locked'a taşınır. Aynı sahnede konuşan iki karakter aynı sesi almaz. Kural (eski bütçe defteri): satır başı en çok 3 deneme, parti başı en çok 3 USD.

narrator.style: Deep, weathered Japanese chronicle narrator; unhurried, intimate, and resonant, letting quiet pauses settle like falling ash.

fadyme.style: Poised young woman with a calm, luminous alto voice; unhurried cadence, subtle dry wit, and gentle warmth beneath composed restraint.

mahmut.style: Grounded, travel-worn knight with a calm low baritone; economical phrasing, steady protective warmth, and understated dry humor.

brin_alder.style: Twenty-three-year-old village guard and woodcutter; sturdy, plain-spoken and few words, warm but immovable.

clem_marr.style: Nineteen-year-old gravedigger's granddaughter; chatty, quirky and upbeat about a gloomy trade.

hana_birch.style: Eighteen-year-old gamekeeper's daughter; very shy and quiet, awkward with greetings, focused in the hunt.

iona_mist.style: Twenty-four-year-old river lantern keeper; calm, soothing and gentle, a guiding voice in fog.

jori_flint.style: Twenty-year-old blacksmith; blunt, proud and principled, a hard edge with a warm core.

kera_voss.style: Twenty-year-old alchemist girl; quick, wry and self-assured, a mischievous grin in the voice, playful confidence.

marek_vane.style: Thirty-year-old former border guard and herald; wry, weary and warm, a storyteller's rhythm.
marek_vane.provisional: 2026-11-22: Claude's pick so the first build has voices; the owner can change it (ask in chat or the panel) and the lines are re-recorded

mirel_quill.style: Twenty-five-year-old former court scribe and archivist; precise, composed and articulate, a hint of self-reproach.

nara_vell.style: Twenty-seven-year-old hereditary bridge warden; steady, grounded and quietly authoritative, a protector.

nixie_vale.style: Nineteen-year-old caravan scout and archer; energetic, curious and quick, always ready to run ahead.

odelia_pike.style: Twenty-two-year-old harbor watcher and archer; shy and hesitant with people, but sharp and sure when she shoots.

pippa_bell.style: Twenty-year-old travelling singer; cheerful, musical and lilting, warm and open to everyone.

refugee_woman.style: Frightened refugee woman in her thirties; breathless, hushed and quick, trying not to be overheard.

rikka_ember.style: Eighteen-year-old festival spear-guard; loud, bright and bubbling with excitement, big festival energy.

sable_wren.style: Twenty-one-year-old courier and assassin; cool, low and quiet, guarded, every word measured.

shrine_keeper.style: Elderly wayshrine keeper; warm, slow and kind, a gentle mystery in the voice, speaking like a blessing.

sister_aveline.style: Twenty-six-year-old wandering field sister and healer; calm, firm and kind, the steadiness of someone who has worked in triage.
sister_aveline.provisional: 2026-11-22: Claude's pick so the first build has voices; the owner can change it (ask in chat or the panel) and the lines are re-recorded

thistle_roe.style: Twenty-one-year-old monastery bell gardener; gentle, nervous and stammering, sweet and earnest.

tilda_fen.style: Twenty-four-year-old field surgeon from the salt coast; brisk, practical and blunt, caring hidden under impatience.

vespera_wisp.style: Twenty-three-year-old glass mage; dreamy, soft and mysterious, slightly unsettling calm.

cassian_thorne.style: Twenty-seven-year-old cathedral templar who counts the living; solemn, low and dutiful, grief held under strict control.

corbin_locke.style: Twenty-nine-year-old sluice warden; terse, practical and level, a man who reads water better than people.

dorian_kesk.style: Twenty-six-year-old forger of papers; smooth, sly and amused, charming with a conspiratorial wink.

garrick_cinder.style: Thirty-three-year-old former gate captain; gruff, weary and stubborn, old guilt burning under a steady voice.

rowan_reed.style: Nineteen-year-old wayshrine keeper and carver; gentle, earnest and warm, a young man who remembers every name.

kera_voss.style: Twenty-year-old alchemist girl; quick, wry and self-assured, a mischievous grin in the voice, playful confidence.
kera_voss.text_ja: ケラ・ヴォス、赤い薬瓶の書庫係。先に言っておくけど、爆発はしないわ。……たぶんね。<long pause> リダウト反応――下がって！

brin_alder.style: Twenty-three-year-old village guard and woodcutter; sturdy, plain-spoken and few words, warm but immovable.
brin_alder.text_ja: ブリン・アルダー。支えるのが私の仕事。<long pause> アルダーウォール！

nixie_vale.style: Nineteen-year-old caravan scout and archer; energetic, curious and quick, always ready to run ahead.
nixie_vale.text_ja: ニクシー・ヴェイル！斥候で弓使いで、木登りのプロ！で、どこ行くの？<long pause> 峠の上に鷹を！

sister_aveline.name_ja: シスター・アヴェリン
sister_aveline.style: Twenty-six-year-old wandering field sister and healer; calm, firm and kind, the steadiness of someone who has worked in triage.
sister_aveline.text_ja: 聖ルトスのシスター・アヴェリンです。まず人を。質問はそのあとで。<long pause> 最後の扉に朝課の祈りを！

sable_wren.style: Twenty-one-year-old courier and assassin; cool, low and quiet, guarded, every word measured.
sable_wren.text_ja: セーブル。運び屋。ほかの名前は要らないでしょう。<long pause> 名は奪った。静寂のうちに。

tilda_fen.style: Twenty-four-year-old field surgeon from the salt coast; brisk, practical and blunt, caring hidden under impatience.
tilda_fen.text_ja: ティルダ・フェン、治療師よ。血が出てるなら座って。出てないなら動いて。<long pause> 塩の道に雨を。

rikka_ember.style: Eighteen-year-old festival spear-guard; loud, bright and bubbling with excitement, big festival energy.
rikka_ember.text_ja: 窯の組のリッカ・エンバー！うるさくて、明るくて、槍の腕はすっごくいいよ！<long pause> 火の粉の行列！みんな、声を上げて！

mirel_quill.style: Twenty-five-year-old former court scribe and archivist; precise, composed and articulate, a hint of self-reproach.
mirel_quill.text_ja: 書庫番のミレル・クイル。記録を正すのが仕事です。……自分の記録も、いくつか。<long pause> 不落の勅令！

odelia_pike.style: Twenty-two-year-old harbor watcher and archer; shy and hesitant with people, but sharp and sure when she shoots.
odelia_pike.text_ja: オデリア・パイク。わ、私……足跡を追います。港の生まれです。<long pause> 防波堤の一斉射！

pippa_bell.style: Twenty-year-old travelling singer; cheerful, musical and lilting, warm and open to everyone.
pippa_bell.text_ja: 旅の歌い手、ピッパ・ベル！どの名前にも一節ずつ歌をあげる！<long pause> 長い道のための歌を！

nara_vell.style: Twenty-seven-year-old hereditary bridge warden; steady, grounded and quietly authoritative, a protector.
nara_vell.text_ja: 橋守のナラ・ヴェル。誰もが渡る。<long pause> 狭き門は持ちこたえる！

clem_marr.style: Nineteen-year-old gravedigger's granddaughter; chatty, quirky and upbeat about a gloomy trade.
clem_marr.text_ja: クレム・マー！お墓を読むの。心配しないで、古いのだけだから。<long pause> 逆さの墓碑銘！

vespera_wisp.name_ja: ヴェスペラ・ウィスプ
vespera_wisp.style: Twenty-three-year-old glass mage; dreamy, soft and mysterious, slightly unsettling calm.
vespera_wisp.text_ja: ヴェスペラ。硝子を研究しているの。硝子のほうも、私を見ている。<long pause> 青白い灯の行列。

hana_birch.style: Eighteen-year-old gamekeeper's daughter; very shy and quiet, awkward with greetings, focused in the hunt.
hana_birch.text_ja: ハナ・バーチ。わ、罠の見張りを……してます。こんにちは。<long pause> 白樺の伏兵！

thistle_roe.style: Twenty-one-year-old monastery bell gardener; gentle, nervous and stammering, sweet and earnest.
thistle_roe.text_ja: シ、シスル・ロウ。鐘の庭師です。いろいろ育ててます。……だいたいは。<long pause> 冬の前に庭を！

iona_mist.style: Twenty-four-year-old river lantern keeper; calm, soothing and gentle, a guiding voice in fog.
iona_mist.text_ja: 川灯守のイオナ・ミスト。霧の中を、ひとりで渡らせはしません。<long pause> 霧の中の安らぎの港。

jori_flint.style: Twenty-year-old blacksmith; blunt, proud and principled, a hard edge with a warm core.
jori_flint.text_ja: ジョリ・フリント。鍛冶屋よ。作るのは盾。鎖じゃない。覚えておいて。<long pause> 炉の扉――閉じろ！

marek_vane.style: Thirty-year-old former border guard and herald; wry, weary and warm, a storyteller's rhythm.
marek_vane.text_ja: マレク・ヴェイン、今はもう何の伝令でもない。紙の代わりに、人を運んでいる。<long pause> 旗なき行進！

cassian_thorne.style: Twenty-seven-year-old cathedral templar who counts the living; solemn, low and dutiful, grief held under strict control.
cassian_thorne.text_ja: カシアン・ソーン。剣は大聖堂のものだった。指輪は自分で取った。名が守られるまで、どちらも背負っていく。<long pause> 舌なき鐘に、鐘賃はなし。我がために鳴れ！

corbin_locke.style: Twenty-nine-year-old sluice warden; terse, practical and level, a man who reads water better than people.
corbin_locke.text_ja: コービン・ロック、水門番だ。水は読める。人のほうが難しい。<long pause> 下の水門を開けろ。全部だ！

dorian_kesk.style: Twenty-six-year-old forger of papers; smooth, sly and amused, charming with a conspiratorial wink.
dorian_kesk.text_ja: ドリアン・ケスク。扉を開ける書類を作っている。中には本物もあるさ。<long pause> 第七の刻み。封印、そして無効！

garrick_cinder.name_ja: ギャリック・シンダー
garrick_cinder.style: Thirty-three-year-old former gate captain; gruff, weary and stubborn, old guilt burning under a steady voice.
garrick_cinder.text_ja: ギャリック・シンダー。かつて門を守った。時計が『もう遅い』と言うまでな。予定表なんぞ渡すな。<long pause> 六十一分目。今度こそは！

rowan_reed.style: Nineteen-year-old wayshrine keeper and carver; gentle, earnest and warm, a young man who remembers every name.
rowan_reed.text_ja: ロワン・リード。道祠と、そこに刻まれた名前を守っています。あなたの名前も教えてください。覚えておきますから。<long pause> すべての名を、忘れずに。燃え上がれ！
